p.src: The World Bank’s Changing Wealth of Nations 2024 report is helpful here because it insists that wealth cannot be reduced to GDP. A country may grow output while depleting the underlying asset base that future growth depends on. The same is true for a household or a business. Revenue alone can hide depletion.
